newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares continue slide on poor turnover.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares continue slide on poor turnover.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased another 0.81 percent on Thursday on low turnover and traders said the underlying pessimism in the market was likely to continue weighing on prices over the coming week.
"There is apathy in our market -- the turning point could come next week, but it is hard to say in which direction prices will move then," Jernej Obed, a trader at "A" bank, said.
* The SBI index fell 11.14 points to 1,367.64.
* Overall six shares fell, seven rose and 13 were untraded.
* Turnover fell to 54.6 million tolars from 109.8 million. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
